purpose: exposure bracket through the polarising dome, per HANDOFF_MORNING_dome_photo.md section 6
optic: radial dome fitted over the lens (gore seams visible in every frame)
heading_note: operator reported 'front of the camera facing north', camera on the ground pointing at the zenith. NOT recorded as a heading because 'front of the camera' does not unambiguously identify which image edge points North, and no compass reading was taken. Must be resolved before any azimuth error is quoted.
sky_conditions: broken to mostly cloudy, small patches of blue near the zenith
site: ground level beside a building; trees fill the north and west field, the building fills the south-east quadrant. Roughly 40 per cent of the 15 to 60 degree annulus is open sky.
note: Exposure bracket only. NOT a usable polarisation measurement: cloud plus obstruction. See EXPOSURE_NOTES.md.
